title: Carepoint admin sign-in and clinic UI refresh

assessment_snapshot.intro: The workspace contains an existing Spring Boot clinic-management application with a static HTML/CSS/JavaScript UI and a configured MySQL connection:
bullets: Spring Boot 4.1.1 / Java 17 with existing doctor, patient, appointment, and schedule APIs
Static browser UI built with HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript; no frontend framework is currently configured
MySQL database settings use environment-variable overrides and existing patient/appointment data must be considered
The request adds login, signup, and admin-only dashboard access; no authentication system or role policy is currently established
Lombok is already present as a project dependency

proposed_outcome: Keep the current Spring Boot and lightweight frontend architecture unless explicitly changed; apply a distinctive, consistent professional theme across public, authentication, and admin pages; add secure login and signup plus server-enforced authorization so only an authenticated admin can access clinic-management APIs and dashboard data; preserve existing patient and appointment data and behavior; use Lombok only where it makes Java code clearer without compromising validation or security.
